title: Comparative outcomes of DSAEK and DMEK in eyes with prior Ahmed glaucoma valve implantation

groups.description: Ultrathin DSAEK (precut eye-bank tissue, graft thickness below 100 um, described by the authors as ultra-thin DSAEK) for endothelial decompensation in eyes with a prior Ahmed glaucoma valve (AGV); primary grafts only (no prior corneal transplantation); no simultaneous or subsequent cataract surgery (phakic eyes left phakic); two surgeons; one of two standard techniques compared without an investigational arm.

DMEK (precut, preloaded eye-bank grafts) for endothelial decompensation in eyes with a prior AGV; primary grafts only; no simultaneous or subsequent cataract surgery; single surgeon; intraoperative AGV valve-tip trimming in 2 DMEK eyes (one later had valve-tip repositioning at 4 months); one of two standard techniques compared without an investigational arm.

series.notes: Mean ± SD of logMAR BCVA (Methods: BCVA measured with a Snellen chart and converted to logMAR units). Rows: preoperative, 1 week (0.23 month), 1, 3 and 6 months. Analysed eyes 16 at every cited visit (no DSAEK graft failure by 6 months; Results and footnote ‡). The 12-month cell is excluded (failed grafts removed from the analysis). Asterisks mark significance versus preoperative and are not part of the value.

Mean ± SD of logMAR BCVA (Methods: Snellen converted to logMAR units). Rows: preoperative, 1 week (0.23 month), 1 and 3 months, analysed eyes 11 at every cited visit. The 6- and 12-month cells are excluded (10 eyes after removal of the failed graft). Asterisks mark significance versus preoperative and are not part of the value.

notes: Table 2 labels the outcome 'logMAR VA'; the Methods state that BCVA was assessed at every visit and was measured with a Snellen chart and converted to logMAR units, and the abstract reports the Table 2 comparison as BCVA, so the series are admitted as best-corrected acuity.

Inclusion criteria: AGV in the operated eye, no prior corneal transplantation and a minimum follow-up of 12 months; the Methods state that all eligible cases were included consecutively with no exclusions among AGV eyes undergoing DSAEK or DMEK, so the minimum follow-up is not read as a complete-case subset of a larger operated group.
At each postoperative time point the authors excluded eyes whose graft had failed by that visit; only the visits at which every eye of the group was analysed are cited.
The convention used for counting-fingers or hand-motion acuity in the logMAR conversion is not stated.
Eyes needing rebubbling remain in their groups (Table 6, not used).
Endothelial cell density (Table 3), endothelial cell loss (Table 4) and central corneal thickness (Table 5) are tabulated; not extracted (schema 1.0.0).
Glaucoma diagnoses, AGV variants, lens status and vitrectomy history are given per group in Table 1.
Record-level procedure is the first group's (dsaek); each group declares its own procedure.
